transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because I've been trying for over a year to get someone to actually take me seriously. It’s about my job. They started this new ticket rotation, along with these security audits... and it's being used to build a paper trail against me. I've brought it up, but management just keeps showing me system logs and saying it’s just policy. So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you ever heard, seen, or sensed things that others around you could not perceive?
No. I don't... I don't see things, if that's what you're asking. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you feel like you have to be constantly on guard with people in your life, even outside of your workplace?
No... I wouldn't say that. I mostly just keep to myself on my own time. It's really just... the situation at my job that I'm dealing with.
Do you find yourself questioning the loyalty or trustworthiness of your friends or family members as well?
No... no, not really. My family is fine. It's just... like I said, it's just the people at work. That's where the issue is.
Even when your managers show you the system logs and explain the policy, do you still feel certain that they are specifically targeting you?

Yes... I mean, they say it's just policy. They show me the logs. But... I've been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously for over a year now. 

The new ticket rotation, the security audits... they're just using all of it to build a paper trail against me. That's... that's why I'm here.
Are there any other situations, besides your job, where you feel like people are trying to harm you or act against you?
No. I... I don't have this issue anywhere else. Just at work.
Has this situation at work caused you to miss days, receive warnings, or have any trouble maintaining your professional responsibilities?

I haven't missed days. I... I still do my job. But I've had to be careful. I don't take on certain network projects anymore. And I have to spend a lot of time documenting everything in my tickets... just to cover myself. It takes longer. The team meetings are... uncomfortable now. People get frustrated because things are moving slower, but I have to protect myself.
When your managers show you those logs and explain the policy, do you ever consider the possibility that you might be misinterpreting their intentions?

No. I... I don't think I am. 

Like I just said, I've been dealing with this for over a year. They can call the audits and the ticket rotations "policy" and point at the logs all they want, but... I know a paper trail when I see one. I wouldn't be sitting here trying to get someone to finally take this seriously if I thought I was just... misinterpreting things.
Do you believe that your managers are acting alone in this, or do you feel that others in the company or outside the company are also involved in this effort against you?
Just my managers. I... I haven't seen anything to make me think anyone else is involved. They're the ones running the audits. I don't know why anyone outside would care.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels over this past year?
No, not really. I sleep fine. My appetite is... normal. I'm just tired sometimes from dealing with work, but nothing out of the ordinary.
Do you feel that your managers are targeting you because they believe you possess some unique knowledge, skill, or secret that they want to extract or suppress?
No, nothing like that. I... I don't have any kind of secret. I'm just doing standard support work. I don't really know why they started doing this... I just know that they are.
Do you feel that you have any special abilities or powers that others around you do not have?
No. I... I'm just a regular person. I just do my job. No powers or... anything like that.
